questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3500 as a sum borrowed at 5% per year rate of interest for 2 years.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3500

Rate (R) = 5% per year

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times T}{100}

**Calculations:**

SI = dfrac{3500 times 5 times 2}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{35000}{100}

⇒ SI = 350

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: Reduce (374)/(418) to the lowest term.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Fraction: dfrac{374}{418}

**Formula used:**

To reduce the fraction to its lowest terms, we divide both the numerator and the denominator by their greatest common divisor (GCD).

**Calculation:**

HCF of 374 and 418 is 22.

⇒ dfrac{374 div 22}{418 div 22} = dfrac{17}{19}

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**

questions.question: A cylinder with a radius of 12 cm and height of 38 cm is cut parallel to the base into two pieces of different sizes. The total surface area of the larger piece formed is 60% of the total surface area of the given cylinder. The smaller piece is melted and used to create a sphere. Find the radius (in cm) of the sphere.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of Cylinder = 12 cm

Height = 38 cm

**Formula used:**

Surface area of the cylinder = 2πr(h + r)

Volume of the cylinder = πr²h

Volume of the sphere = (4/3)πr³

**Calculations:**

Total surface area of the cylinder = 2πr(h + r)

Let the height of the larger piece be H

Total surface area of the larger piece = 60% of 2πr(h + r)

⇒ 2πr² + 2πrH = 0.6 x 2πr(h + r) 

⇒ 2πr (r + H) = 0.6 x 2πr(h + r) 

⇒ (12 + H) = 0.6 x (38 + 12) 

⇒ 12 + H = 30 cm

⇒ H = 18 cm

So the height of the smaller piece = Hₛₘₐₗₗ = 38 - 18 = 20 cm

Volume of the smaller piece = Volume of the Sphere

⇒ πr2Hsmall = 4/3 πR³

⇒ (12)² x 20 = 4/3 R3

⇒ (8640) / 4 = R3

⇒ R = 6 times sqrt[3]{10} 

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**

questions.question: A man bought an article for ₹500 and sold it for ₹600. Find his profit percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹500

Selling Price (SP) = ₹600

**Formula used:**

Profit Percentage = dfrac{(SP - CP)}{CP} times 100

**Calculation:**

Profit = SP - CP = ₹600 - ₹500 = ₹100

⇒ Profit Percentage = dfrac{100}{500} times 100

⇒ Profit Percentage = 0.2 × 100 = 20%

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: Aniruddh invested ₹15,000 in the shares of a company. The shares rose by 15% one day and fell by 10% on the other day. What is the current value (in ₹) of Aniruddh's investment?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial Investment (P) = ₹15,000

Increase = 15%

Decrease = 10%

**Formula used:**

Final Value = P × (1 + Increase/100) × (1 - Decrease/100)

**Calculations:**

Final Value = 15000 × (1 + 15/100) × (1 - 10/100)

⇒ Final Value = 15000 × 1.15 × 0.90

⇒ Final Value = 15525

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: A and B are running in the same direction at the speeds of 9km/h and 3km/h, respectively, on a circular track of length 27 km. They will meet again after:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of A = 9 km/h

Speed of B = 3 km/h

Length of circular track = 27 km

**Formula used:**

Relative speed when running in the same direction = Speed of A - Speed of B

Time taken to meet again = Length of the track / Relative speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 9 km/h - 3 km/h

⇒ Relative speed = 6 km/h

Time taken to meet again = 27 km / 6 km/h

⇒ Time taken = 4.5 hours

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**

questions.question: In the what ratio must a shopkeeper mix 2 types of rice worth ₹80/kg and ₹100/kg, so that the average cost of the mixture is ₹95/kg?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost of type 1 rice (C₁) = ₹80/kg

Cost of type 2 rice (C₂) = ₹100/kg

Average cost of mixture (Cₘ) = ₹95/kg

**Formula used:**

Using the rule of alligation:

Ratio = (C₂ - Cₘ) : (Cₘ - C₁)

**Calculation:**

Ratio = (100 - 95) : (95 - 80)

⇒ Ratio = 5 : 15

⇒ Ratio = 1 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: The external and internal diameters of a hollow cylindrical pipe are 14 cm and 12 cm, respectively. What is the volume of iron used to make the pipe if the height of the pipe is 21 cm? (Use π = (22)/(7) )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of material = π × (R + r) × (R − r) × h

Radii: R = 14/2 = 7 cm and r = 12/2 = 6 cm

Volume = (22/7) × (7 + 6) × (7 − 6) × 21

Volume = 22 × 13 × 1 × 3 = 858 cu.cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 858 cu.cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

External diameter (D) = 14 cm → External radius (R) = 7 cm

Internal diameter (d) = 12 cm → Internal radius (r) = 6 cm

Height (h) = 21 cm

Formula used: Volume of hollow cylinder = π × (R² − r²) × h

 
 
 
• 
• R=7 r=6 
• h = 21 cm Hollow Cylindrical Pipe 

Calculations:

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × (7² − 6²) × 21

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × (49 − 36) × 21

⇒ Volume = 22 × 13 × 3

⇒ Volume = 286 × 3

⇒ Volume = 858 cu.cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 858 cu.cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Solid Cylinder

The volume of a solid cylinder is given by V = πr²h, where r is the radius and h is the height.

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Hollow Cylinder

The total CSA is the sum of external and internal surface areas: CSA = 2πRh + 2πrh = 2πh(R + r).

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Hollow Cylinder

TSA = CSA + Area of two circular bases = 2πh(R + r) + 2π(R² − r²) = 2π(R + r)(h + R − r).

questions.question: Find the ratio of the curved surface areas of two cones if the diameters of the bases are equal and slant heights are in the ratio 5 : 3.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two cones with equal diameters of bases

Slant heights ratio = 5 : 3

**Formula used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cone = πrl

Where, r = radius of the base, l = slant height

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of both cones be r.

Let the slant heights be 5x and 3x.

CSA of first cone = πr × 5x

CSA of second cone = πr × 3x

Ratio of CSAs = (πr × 5x) / (πr × 3x)

⇒ Ratio = 5/3

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.question:
The actual and targeted production (in thousands) of shoes of a company during the last five years are given in the following bar graph. Study the bar graph carefully and answer the question that follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4eaf11349f8a22251bf9fafc0d453df0526371816d1175439c1bdb7b5a767ee.png] 

The total actual production in 2020 and 2021 is what per cent of the total targeted production in 2021 and 2022? (correct up to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Actual production in 2020 = 17000

Actual production in 2021 = 19000

Targeted production in 2021 = 20000

Targeted production in 2022 = 31000

**Formula used:**

Total actual production in 2020 and 2021 = Actual production in 2020 + Actual production in 2021

Total targeted production in 2021 and 2022 = Targeted production in 2021 + Targeted production in 2022

Percentage = (Total actual production / Total targeted production) × 100

**Calculations:**

Total actual production in 2020 and 2021 = 17000 + 19000

⇒ Total actual production = 36000

Total targeted production in 2021 and 2022 = 20000 + 31000

⇒ Total targeted production = 51000

Percentage = (36000 / 51000) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 70.59%

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: A car driver covers a total distance of 120 km. He covers the first 80 km at a uniform speed of 50 km/h and the next 40 km at a uniform speed of 40 km/h. The average speed of the car is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A car driver covers a total distance of 120 km.

He covers the first 80 km at a uniform speed of 50 km/h.

He covers the next 40 km at a uniform speed of 40 km/h.

**Formula used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance / Total Time

**Calculation:**

Time for first part = Distance / Speed = 80 km / 50 km/h

⇒ Time for first part = 1.6 hours

Time for second part = Distance / Speed = 40 km / 40 km/h

⇒ Time for second part = 1 hour

Total Time = Time for first part + Time for second part = 1.6 hours + 1 hour

⇒ Total Time = 2.6 hours

Average Speed = Total Distance / Total Time

⇒ Average Speed = 120 km / 2.6 hours = 46(2)/(13) km/h

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.question: The average weight of 12 students and two teachers is 55 kg. When one teacher weighing 68 kg is included in the group, then the average weight of the group (in kg) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of 12 students and two teachers is 55 kg.

One teacher weighing 68 kg is included in the group.

**Formula used:**

Average weight = Total weight / Number of people

**Calculation:**

Total weight of 12 students and 2 teachers = 55 × 14

⇒ Total weight = 770 kg

Including one more teacher weighing 68 kg:

New total weight = 770 + 68 = 838 kg

New number of people = 14 + 1 = 15

New average weight = 838 / 15

⇒ New average weight = 55.86 ≈ 56 kg

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

questions.question: The difference between discounts on a bill for ₹22,500 under two schemes, a discount of 40% and two successive discounts of 36% and 4%, is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Bill amount = ₹22,500

First scheme discount = 40%

Second scheme discounts = 36% and 4%

**Formula used:**

Final price after discount = Original price × (1 - Discount rate)

For successive discounts: Final price after first discount × (1 - Second discount rate)

**Calculation:**

First scheme:

Final price after 40% discount = 22500 × (1 - 0.40)

⇒ 22500 × 0.60 = 13500

Second scheme:

Final price after 36% discount = 22500 × (1 - 0.36)

⇒ 22500 × 0.64 = 14400

Final price after additional 4% discount = 14400 × (1 - 0.04)

⇒ 14400 × 0.96 = 13824

Difference between the two final prices = 13824 - 13500

⇒ 324

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
